examples.name: spw_rmap_node
examples.title: SpaceWire RMAP target
examples.description: SpaceWire RMAP target: an OpenWire port and an OpenRMAP target with its memory interface.

examples.name: spp_over_spw
examples.title: Space Packets over SpaceWire
examples.description: Space Packets over SpaceWire: OpenSPP behind the pass-through port of an OpenRMAP target, which shares one OpenWire port.

examples.name: spp_over_spw_two_clocks
examples.title: Space Packets over SpaceWire, two clocks
examples.description: Space Packets over SpaceWire with two clock domains: the SpaceWire side runs on a 50 MHz port clock, the Space Packet node on the 100 MHz system clock. The Composer inserts asynchronous FIFOs for the packet links. An ECC monitor, marked as the system ECC monitor, reports the corrected and detected errors of these FIFOs.

examples.name: encrypted_spp_over_spw
examples.title: Encrypted packets over SpaceWire
examples.description: Encrypted packets over SpaceWire: the OpenCrypto framer cuts every input packet (for example a compressed image) into chunks, the AES-GCM core encrypts every chunk with a generated IV and a 4-byte position in the AAD, and OpenSPP sends every encrypted chunk as one Space Packet through an N-Char adapter and an OpenWire port. An ECC monitor reports the corrected and detected errors of the buffers of the framer.

examples.name: compressed_images_over_spw
examples.title: Compressed and encrypted images over SpaceWire
examples.description: Compressed and encrypted images over SpaceWire: OpenCompact compresses multispectral images of 128 x 128 samples in 16 bands of 12 bits losslessly (CCSDS 123.0-B-2, BIP order), the OpenCrypto framer cuts every compressed image into chunks, the AES-GCM core encrypts every chunk, and OpenSPP sends every encrypted chunk as one Space Packet through an N-Char adapter and an OpenWire port. An ECC monitor reports the corrected and detected errors of the memories of the compressor and of the buffers of the framer. The throughput budget assumes a compression ratio of 2: an assumption about the images, not a property of the core; the brief marks every number that depends on it.

examples.name: spacefibre_node
examples.title: SpaceFibre node
examples.description: SpaceFibre node: an OpenFibre port with its AMD Versal GTY adapter carries RMAP on virtual channel 0 (an OpenRMAP target through an N-Char adapter) and Space Packets on virtual channel 1 (OpenSPP, directly on the channel). The assignment of the channels is a convention of this example, not of the cores: any channel carries any packets, and both ends of the link use the same assignment.
